table.name: california_schools_2014_2015
table.purpose: One row per California public school for the 2014-2015 academic year, combining CDS identifying codes, school/district attributes (type, grade span, charter status, NSLP provision) and enrollment/demographic counts with rates. Structure matches a California Department of Education school-level file (CDS code, county/district/school codes, Educational Options, charter fields).

col_001.name: cds_code
col_001.description: 14-digit County-District-School (CDS) code uniquely identifying each school; primary key. Concatenation of county code (2 digits), district code (5 digits), school code (7 digits), matching col_003/col_004/col_005.

col_002.name: academic_year
col_002.description: Academic year the record refers to; constant '2014-2015' in this table.

col_003.name: county_code
col_003.description: Two-digit California county code (e.g. 19 = Los Angeles, 37 = San Diego); pairs with county name in col_006.

col_004.name: district_code
col_004.description: Five-digit district code component of the CDS code (e.g. 64733 = Los Angeles Unified).

col_005.name: school_code
col_005.description: Seven-digit school code component of the CDS code; '0000000' (45 rows) likely district-level/office records rather than schools.

col_006.name: county_name
col_006.description: Name of the California county (Los Angeles, San Diego, El Dorado, Kings, Sacramento, ...).

col_007.name: district_name
col_007.description: Name of the school district or administrative body (e.g. 'Los Angeles Unified', 'Elk Grove Unified', county offices of education).

col_008.name: school_name
col_008.description: Name of the school (or 'District Office' for district-level rows).

col_009.name: district_type
col_009.description: Type of the administrative body: Unified School District, Elementary School District, High School District, County Office of Education, State Board of Education, Non-School Locations.

col_010.name: educational_option_type
col_010.description: CDE 'Educational Options' category of the school: Elementary Schools (Public), High Schools (Public), Intermediate/Middle, Continuation High Schools, Alternative Schools of Choice, etc.

col_011.name: school_type
col_011.description: Low-level school type: Traditional, Continuation School, Alternative School of Choice, Community Day School, Special Education School, Juvenile Court School, etc.

col_012.name: nslp_provision_type
col_012.description: National School Lunch Program provision status (Provision 1/2/3, Breakfast Provision 2, CEP = Community Eligibility Provision); null for most schools (no special provision).

col_013.name: is_charter
col_013.description: Flag indicating the school is a charter school (1 = yes, ~11.7%); consistent with col_014/col_015 being populated only for these rows.

col_014.name: charter_number
col_014.description: Charter school number (CDE charter ID); populated only for charter schools (null rate 0.883 matches the charter flag).

col_015.name: charter_funding_type
col_015.description: Charter funding model: 'Directly funded' or 'Locally funded'; populated only for charter schools.

col_016.name: dass_flag
col_016.description: 0/1 flag set for ~7.3% of schools. Plausibly the DASS (Dashboard Alternative School Status) flag given the many continuation/alternative schools present, but the data alone does not confirm which flag it is.

col_017.name: lowest_grade_offered
col_017.description: Lowest grade level offered by the school ('K' = kindergarten, 'P' = preschool/pre-K, else numeric grade).

col_018.name: highest_grade_offered
col_018.description: Highest grade level offered (values 1-13 plus 'K'; 13 likely denotes ungraded/adult or transitional programs).

col_019.name: enrollment_total
col_019.description: Total enrollment of the school (e.g. 102, 4, 2190). Denominator for the rates in col_021 and col_023.

col_020.name: subgroup_a_count
col_020.description: Count of a student subgroup over total enrollment (col_019); col_021 = col_020/col_019. The specific subgroup (e.g. free/reduced-price meal eligible, an ethnicity, or gender) cannot be determined from the data alone.

col_021.name: subgroup_a_rate
col_021.description: Proportion col_020/col_019 (0-1); subgroup identity unresolved, same as col_020.

col_022.name: subgroup_b_count
col_022.description: Count of a second student subgroup over total enrollment (col_019); col_023 = col_022/col_019. Subgroup identity unresolved.

col_024.name: enrollment_adjusted
col_024.description: A second, slightly smaller enrollment figure (e.g. 73 vs 102, 2132 vs 2190), likely enrollment excluding some grades/students (e.g. kindergarten or ungraded); denominator for col_026 and col_028.

col_025.name: subgroup_a_count_adjusted
col_025.description: Count of the same subgroup as col_020 but against the adjusted enrollment (col_024); col_026 = col_025/col_024.

col_027.name: subgroup_b_count_adjusted
col_027.description: Count of the same subgroup as col_022 but against the adjusted enrollment (col_024); col_028 = col_027/col_024.

table.name: satscores
table.purpose: California schools/districts SAT (or similar standardized test) results: one row per school or district (CDS code), with enrollment, number of test takers, and average section scores. County, district names, and 14-digit CDS codes strongly indicate California Department of Education data. The exact test/subject labels for the score columns cannot be confirmed from values alone, so those remain tentative.

col_001.name: cds_code
col_001.description: 14-digit CDS (County-District-School) code uniquely identifying each school or district; primary key of the table.

col_002.name: record_type
col_002.description: Record level: 'S' = school, 'D' = district. Consistent with rows where col_003 (school name) is null being 'D'.

col_003.name: school_name
col_003.description: Name of the school; null for district-level ('D') rows.

col_004.name: district_name
col_004.description: Name of the school district (or county office of education) the record belongs to.

col_005.name: county
col_005.description: California county name (Los Angeles, San Diego, Humboldt, etc.).

col_006.name: enrollment
col_006.description: Enrollment count (likely grade-12 enrollment) for the school/district; always populated, wide range 0-43324.

col_007.name: test_takers
col_007.description: Number of students taking the test; heavily skewed toward small counts (0, 1, 2...) and always <= col_006, consistent with a count of examinees.

col_008.name: avg_score_section_1
col_008.description: Average score on the first test section (e.g. SAT critical reading/verbal). Range 308-653 with mean ~480 fits SAT section means; null when no scores reported. Exact section identity unconfirmed.

col_009.name: avg_score_section_2
col_009.description: Average score on the second test section (e.g. SAT math). Range 289-699, mean ~484; null pattern identical to col_008/col_010. Exact section identity unconfirmed.

col_010.name: avg_score_section_3
col_010.description: Average score on the third test section (e.g. SAT writing). Range 312-671, mean ~473; null pattern identical to col_008/col_009. Exact section identity unconfirmed.

table.name: california_public_schools_directory
table.purpose: Directory of California public schools and educational agencies (CDE-style): one row per school/site with CDS code, location, contacts, type, grade span, open/close dates and status.

col_001.name: cds_code
col_001.description: 14-digit CDS (County-District-School) code, unique identifier for the school/site; primary key.

col_002.name: district_code
col_002.description: 7-digit district (LEA) code; first two digits match the county FIPS code (e.g. 06xxxxx).

col_003.name: school_code
col_003.description: 5-digit school code within the district (part of the CDS code); null for district-level/COE rows.

col_004.name: status
col_004.description: Administrative status of the school: Active, Closed, Merged, or Pending.

col_006.name: district_name
col_006.description: Name of the district or responsible educational agency (e.g. 'Los Angeles Unified', county offices of education).

col_008.name: mailing_street_long
col_008.description: Mailing street address, full street-word form (e.g. 'Road', 'Street').

col_009.name: mailing_street_abbrev
col_009.description: Mailing street address, abbreviated form (e.g. 'Rd.', 'St.'); same address as col_008.

col_013.name: physical_street_long
col_013.description: Physical/location street address, full street-word form.

col_014.name: physical_street_abbrev
col_014.description: Physical street address, abbreviated form; same address as col_013.

col_016.name: physical_zip
col_016.description: Physical address ZIP code (5-digit or ZIP+4).

col_018.name: phone
col_018.description: School main phone number, formatted (area code) NNN-NNNN.

col_021.name: date_opened
col_021.description: Date the school opened / first became operational (mode 1980-07-01 is a default/legacy date).

col_022.name: date_closed
col_022.description: Date the school closed; null for open schools. Common values like 1989-06-30 and 2015-06-30 (end of school year) support this.

col_023.name: is_charter
col_023.description: Flag indicating the school is a charter school (1 = yes). Supported by the charter funding-type column (col_025) being populated only for these rows.

col_024.name: charter_number
col_024.description: Charter school number (4-digit code), populated only for charter schools (~10% of rows).

col_025.name: charter_funding_type
col_025.description: Charter funding model: 'Directly funded', 'Locally funded', or 'Not in CS funding model'.

col_026.name: district_type_code
col_026.description: Code for the type of responsible agency/district (e.g. 54 = Unified School District, 00 = COE); pairs with col_027.

col_027.name: district_type
col_027.description: Description of the responsible agency type: Unified/Elementary/High School District, County Office of Education, ROC/P, JPA, etc.

col_028.name: school_type_code
col_028.description: Code for the school type/educational level (e.g. 60 = Elementary, 66 = High School); pairs with col_029.

col_029.name: school_type
col_029.description: School type description: Elementary, High, Middle, Continuation, Special Education, etc.

col_030.name: education_type_code
col_030.description: Abbreviated code for educational option type (TRAD = Traditional, CON = Continuation, COMMDAY = Community Day, etc.); pairs with col_031.

col_031.name: education_type
col_031.description: Educational option type description (Traditional, Continuation School, Community Day School, Juvenile Court School, etc.).

col_032.name: grade_span_category_code
col_032.description: Code for grade-span category (ELEM, HS, UG = ungraded, INTMIDJR, ELEMHIGH, A = adult, PS = preschool); pairs with col_033.

col_033.name: grade_span_category
col_033.description: Grade-span category description (Elementary, High School, Ungraded, Intermediate/Middle/Junior High, etc.).

col_034.name: low_grade
col_034.description: Lowest grade served (e.g. 'K-5' low end 'K'; single values like '10' for ungraded-high schools).

col_035.name: high_grade
col_035.description: Highest grade served (e.g. 'K-5' high end '5'; 'P'/'K' for preschool).

col_038.name: latitude
col_038.description: Latitude of the school location (decimal degrees; range fits California).

col_039.name: longitude
col_039.description: Longitude of the school location (decimal degrees, negative; range fits California).

col_040.name: contact1_first_name
col_040.description: First name of the primary administrative contact (likely principal or administrator).

col_041.name: contact1_last_name
col_041.description: Last name of the primary administrative contact.

col_042.name: contact1_email
col_042.description: Email of the primary administrative contact.

col_043.name: contact2_first_name
col_043.description: First name of a secondary contact (populated for ~2% of rows); exact role (e.g. assistant principal) unknown.

col_044.name: contact2_last_name
col_044.description: Last name of the secondary contact.

col_046.name: contact3_first_name
col_046.description: First name of a third, very sparsely populated contact; role unknown.

col_047.name: contact3_last_name
col_047.description: Last name of the third contact.

col_049.name: last_update_date
col_049.description: Date the directory record was last updated (bulk values 1999-06-24 and 2015-06-18 suggest batch updates).
